subject: Television & Streaming
title: How Ad-Free Changed What Gets Made
description: A quick, practical guide to How Ad-Free Changed What Gets Made.

hook.text: HBO's famous tagline was 'It's not TV, it's HBO.' Without ads, the network didn't need mass audiences.

buildup.text: Ad-free networks could air shows with niche appeal. They needed subscribers, not ratings.

discovery.text: The Sopranos, The Wire, and Six Feet Under existed because HBO didn't need to sell ads.

twist.text: Now streaming services face the same tension.

climax.text: Ad-free television proved that removing commercial pressure unleashes creativity.

punchline.text: Ad-free TV created masterpieces. Then the ads came back.

quiz.question: How did the absence of advertising affect HBO's programming strategy?
options: They could take artistic risks because they needed subscribers, not mass ratings
